description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.5 to 8, with numeric tick labels spaced at an interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from just below 20 to slightly above 30, with numeric tick labels at an interval of 2 and corresponding horizontal dashed gridlines. The plot contains four lines, all demonstrating an upward trend as Average Lagging increases. The "Consistency-CE" line is a light purple dashed line with circle markers, starting at approximately 20.2 at an AL of 0.5 and rising to 29.8 at an AL of 7.8. The "Inconsistency-CE" line is a dark purple dashed line with square markers, increasing from roughly 22.3 at an AL of 1.3 to 29.8 at an AL of 7.8. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is a blue dashed line with square markers, growing from about 22.3 at an AL of 0.8 to 29.5 at an AL of 7.8. Finally, a fourth line, whose label in the legend is obscured by a gray rectangle, is shown as a solid red line with star markers; it increases from approximately 24.9 at an AL of 0.9 to a final value of 30.1 at an AL of 7.9.
